katie: Heads up - noticed a bump in unassigned leads around 07:15 UTC. HS->SF lag high and RR picks owners listed as inactive.
omar: any sample?
katie: pasted sanitized event:
```json
{"hs_id":"hz_900","enrichment":"timeout","rr_choice":"u_12","owner_last_seen_ms":540000,"hs_sf_sync_delay_s":92}
```
lee: quick fix plan: 1) bump enrichment TTL 8s->13s canary 2) enforce fallback_to_overflow=true when enrichment != ok 3) add rr_staleness_gate (skip owners last_seen>5m).
infra-bot: Canary deploy started by lee: hs-ttl-bump at 1779994521.
katie: please post canary metrics after 20m (handoff_success_rate, hs_sf_latency).
omar: i'll draft short playbook snippet for rollback.
lee: rolling monitor: if handoff_success_rate < 90% -> rollback.
katie: thanks team. will coordinate with sales ops before full rollout.
